title: Jacket Potato with Tuna and Sweetcorn
summary: A classic British lunch of crisp-skinned baked potato piled with a creamy tuna and sweetcorn filling. It’s simple, comforting, and filling, with a bright lemony finish.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Scrub the potatoes, prick them all over with a fork, rub with olive oil, and sprinkle with salt.
Bake the potatoes directly on the oven rack for 50 to 60 minutes, until the skins are crisp and the insides are soft when squeezed.
Meanwhile, mix the drained tuna, sweetcorn, mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, spring onion, and black pepper in a bowl.
Split the hot potatoes open, fluff the insides with a fork, and season lightly with a little more salt if needed.
Spoon the tuna and sweetcorn mixture into the potatoes and serve immediately.
